doc: Backend routes no screen calls, each with a reason. Checked by scripts/validate-route-wiring.js: a new unwired route must be classified here; an entry that becomes wired or disappears must be removed.

classes.admin: Platform-admin only; no customer screen by design.
classes.auth_flow: Opened by a browser redirect or an email link, not by the API client.
classes.webhook: Called by a third party (e.g. Stripe).
classes.external_api: For API clients/export tooling; a screen uses another route for the same data.
classes.customer_pending: Built for customers but no screen calls it yet — work not yet reaching customers.

exact:/api/account/onboarding-state.reason: Onboarding progress API; no screen reads it yet.

exact:/api/account/report-branding.reason: Account-level report branding (API only); the Settings screen manages branding through /api/workspaces/:id/branding.

exact:/api/admin/subscriptions.reason: Platform-admin billing inspection; no customer screen by design.

exact:/api/auth/microsoft/login.reason: Old link-based Microsoft start; a followed link is now only sent back to the sign-in page, which starts sign-in with POST /api/auth/microsoft/start.

exact:/api/billing/portal.reason: Account-level Stripe portal session; screens use /api/workspaces/:id/billing/portal.

exact:/api/billing/subscription.reason: Kept for API clients; screens use /api/account/subscription (status made honest in #537).

exact:/api/client-errors.reason: Browser error reports (counted, never stored as text); the frontend reporter is not wired yet.

exact:/api/feedback.reason: The "Something wrong?" button's endpoint; the frontend button is being built against the agreed contract.

exact:/api/plans.reason: Public alias of /api/billing/plans for API clients; screens use /api/billing/plans.

re:^\\/api\\/mcp\\/oauth\\/connections\\.reason: Connection revocation is available to API clients. The Connections screen also builds this URL with an encoded ID; the static route matcher cannot pair that dynamic call with this strict ID pattern.

re:^\\/api\\/portfolio\\/domains\\/([^/].reason: Per-domain MSP portfolio detail; no screen yet.

re:^\\/api\\/scans\\/[^/]+\\/snapshot$.reason: Canonical eight-domain snapshot (M5.c) for export/API clients; screens render through report routes.

re:^\\/api\\/workspaces\\/([^/]+)\\/aler.reason: Workspace alert list + summary API; the Alerts page shows alert channels, not this list.

re:^\\/api\\/workspaces\\/([^/]+)\\/repo.reason: Report retention settings; no screen yet.
Run history of the second scheduled-report API; no screen shows schedule runs yet.
A second scheduled-report API (newer contract); the Reports page manages schedules through /scheduled-reports.
Item route of the second scheduled-report API; the Reports page uses /scheduled-reports/:id.
